name: Pruning
overview: Scripture presents pruning as a deliberate and necessary act of cultivation, exemplified in Leviticus where vineyards are pruned for fruitful harvests and given rest in the sabbath year. Isaiah portrays pruning hooks as tools of both judgment and preparation, cutting away unproductive branches before harvest and symbolizing transformation from instruments of war to tools of peace. The imagery underscores God's sovereign care in shaping His people and creation, removing what hinders growth to foster spiritual fruitfulness and readiness for His purposes.
